entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I... I need to return my VeloBand. I just haven't had a chance to call. It's been a very difficult couple of weeks.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To start, could you tell me, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Oh no, it's not broken or anything. It's just... I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, but things have been tough. My husband had a sudden medical emergency and was rushed to the hospital.
I'm very sorry to hear about your husband. I hope everything is okay.

He needed major surgery, and I've basically been living at the hospital. It all happened right before our son's planned military deployment, too. It's just been one thing after another, and I really, really need this money back. I feel awful about it.
That sounds incredibly stressful. Please don't feel awful. I completely understand. Let me pull up your account and check the policy for you. One moment.

Okay, I see the order here. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered 19 days ago. Let me just consult our knowledge base... Okay, good news. According to our policy, you have 90 days from the delivery date for a return.
Wait, really? 90 days? I thought I read somewhere it was shorter. Oh, that's such a relief. I was so worried I had missed the window.
Nope, you are well within the timeframe. We can absolutely process this for a full refund for you. I'm sending the return shipping label to your email address on file right now.
Thank you, David. Thank you so much. This is one less thing I have to worry about. You have no idea what a help this is.
You are very welcome. I'm glad I could help resolve this for you. Again, I wish your husband a speedy recovery. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for your kindness.
My pleasure. Have a good rest of your day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
